title: A composition of H-projective morphisms is H-projective
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma says that the composite of two H-projective morphisms is again H-projective (statement lines 10630-10633). The counted proof is short and complete: it takes the two defining closed immersions into projective spaces over the respective targets, uses base change and the identification of a projective space over a projective space with a product of two projective spaces over the base to build the displayed commutative diagram, and concludes via the Segre embedding that the composite is a closed subscheme of a projective space over the base (proof lines 10635-10655). It is H2: the construction is carried out in the counted span, with the cited input being the Segre embedding.
